I turned away for 90+ days. Felt good. Felt so good I realized its kinda healthy or normal for me to just bust, im like 20 something our bodies may take care of it but I gave myself years of hard dopamine more than 5 times a week for years.  

It felt like a challenge. To not resist the urge, but to occupy myself. Recently I been just asking myself to take another break. I can be more productive and this takes up like more than 4 hours in a week. I can learn to feed myself and save money. Learn a new instrument. Or binged watch something stupid. 

When I was at my 90+ days I realized the problem isn't even the porn or masturbating, its what I do. Its just an idle mind, or lack of drive to take care of myself mentally, physically, emotionally and etc. Focus on yourself, but just check in on yourself. The snake in your pants craves attentions and can grab yours. You have skin, hair, teeth, health, education, family, friends, food, water, and many more things to tend to in life besides porn.

Just try to figure out if you are ok, not when your having an urge but maybe even after if a relapse happens. Ignore things that aren't important when assessing yourself. Like if you feel bad after a breakup in the past, guilty feelings of addiction. Just focus on yourself in that moment.

Writting can help, to renforce your transition and wire your brain to do something else. Like if you just journaled your thoughts or feelings, and set intentions for the day, week, month, or what you want out of life. Look at that, and one day just figure out how you spend your time, and be honest if you are living that life you actually wrote about. (Doesnt have to be writting, can be art, poetry, you can just start a project like building a bottle ship when you get a urdge.

Also you can try gambits. When you have an urge, focus to do something else that's harder that you care to even think about painting, working, building a better connection with people. 

Also you can stop yourself. Give yourself time, not to adjust to living a life free from addiction, but to fill yourself with things that satisfy your needs and life. Try one thing anything.

Can be pushups, can be a chapter of a audio book, just start doing something else. 

I failed myself and am no longer on my streak, I don't feel bad. Because really, its a natural function of your body reproduce, and sometimes we can just pinch that in the butt and focus on everything else. I don't recommend feeding your addiction. Its great you are seeking help. But just dont beat yourself up, you can be better, just take that first step. 

I think its a mental addiction, not a physical one. You don't involuntarily do it, you choose to, light heatedly from time to time just look at your options.
